segments.caption: An aerial news report shows the aftermath of a serious collision in Douglasville, Georgia, where a red car is crushed under the front of a large freight train on a railroad track that runs parallel to a busy highway. Emergency responders, including police and tow truck crews, are on the scene, and a news helicopter is visible overhead. The broadcast, identified by the "NEW DETAILS" graphic, is covering the incident as it unfolds.

An aerial news report shows the aftermath of a train collision with a red car on the tracks in Douglasville, Georgia, with police and emergency crews on scene. The report then transitions to a map graphic pinpointing the incident at the intersection of East Broad Street and Mozley Street, near Atlanta, while a reporter provides on-site commentary.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, provides a live on-site report at night about a train collision with a car. The broadcast graphics identify the incident location as the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St in Douglasville, Georgia, and show a map of the area with nearby highways. The reporter stands on the roadside, holding a microphone, delivering new details on the developing story.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, delivers a live on-air report from a dark, empty road in Douglasville, Douglas County, at night. He gestures toward the road ahead, indicating the location of a developing story, while the on-screen graphics confirm the live broadcast and the location.

This segment captures a live news report from Douglasville, Georgia, at night, focusing on a serious train collision. The initial frames show the scene from a reporter’s perspective, pointing down a dark, curving road toward the site. The report then transitions to an aerial view revealing the main event: a red car has collided with a black train locomotive on the tracks, with emergency personnel and a tow truck present. The footage documents the aftermath of the accident, highlighting the location

An aerial view captures the aftermath of a collision where a red car has been struck by a black locomotive at a railroad crossing, with emergency personnel and a police vehicle on scene. The segment then cuts to ground-level shots showing responders assessing the damage and a witness pointing toward the incident site, confirming the event occurred at a busy intersection in Atlanta.

A news report from Atlanta documents a train crossing incident, showing railroad workers inspecting a derailed freight car on the tracks while a local resident, Robert Woods, gestures toward the scene, describing the event near his home.
A man gestures toward the scene of a collision where a red car is struck by a train on a railroad crossing in Douglasville, Georgia, as shown in aerial footage.

A red car is shown wedged on railroad tracks, having been struck by a passing train, with people visible on the train's cab. The scene then cuts to a street-level view of vehicles driving over a railroad crossing, highlighting the intersection where the accident occurred.
A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, speaking to the camera as trains pass overhead and cars drive by on the adjacent road.

A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, reporting on a recent incident. The scene shifts to show city workers in safety vests inspecting the area, followed by shots of cars navigating the intersection. The segment concludes with a dramatic nighttime shot of bright headlights, likely from the involved vehicle, illuminating the scene.

A nighttime aerial shot of a city transitions to a daytime street-level view at a railroad crossing, where a school bus is seen crossing the tracks as vehicles wait. The scene then zooms in on the damaged pavement at the crossing, highlighting the infrastructure issue.

A news report details a train derailment incident in Atlanta, showing close-ups of damaged railroad infrastructure and an aerial view of a red car crushed on the tracks by a train. A reporter stands at the scene, gesturing toward the wreckage, while the background shows a busy street intersection with traffic lights and passing vehicles.

An aerial view captures the aftermath of a collision where a red car is severely damaged and wedged on railroad tracks, with a large truck stopped nearby. Emergency responders and bystanders are present, and a tow truck arrives to begin recovery operations. The scene is shown from multiple angles, including ground-level shots of witnesses observing the incident near the tracks.

A news report covers a dramatic train collision with a red car at a railroad crossing. The initial frames show the aftermath, with the damaged vehicle stuck on the tracks as a tow truck arrives to remove it, while emergency personnel and bystanders are present. The report then cuts to an interview with a woman who appears shaken, followed by a live on-site report from news anchor Steve Kiggins, providing updates on the incident.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, delivers a live on-air report from an outdoor location at night. He stands on a roadside, holding a microphone with the station's logo, speaking to the camera as the lower third graphic identifies him, his email, and the location as Atlanta, with a temperature of 48 degrees.
